zh: 看板管理菜单恢复操作焦点，动效使用统一曲线。整齐模式在自身格子内拖动时保持顺序，窄屏纵向缩放保留期望宽度。组件通过既有端口确认初始化，零高度正文不再超时重载。可选能力调用预检提供方，正式调用继续核对授权。运行成本和今日运势缩略图在矮盒中保留主要内容。市场组件安装串行检查冲突，目录与来源记录失败时恢复；损坏来源表保留原文件。看板备份可在全新目录恢复市场组件，保持原始哈希和只读来源。已安装市场组件在没有提供方时仍可从组件库添加。
en: Board management restores action focus and uses shared motion timing. Aligned dragging within the same cell preserves order, and narrow vertical resizing retains the wanted width. Widgets acknowledge initialization through the existing port so zero-height documents do not reload. Optional capability calls check provider availability while host authorization remains mandatory. Short usage and fortune previews retain their primary content. Market installs serialize conflict checks and restore directories and provenance on failure, preserving malformed provenance files. Board backups restore market widgets into fresh homes with their original hashes and read-only source. Installed market widgets remain available to add without a provider.
